blurb:
Begin your day in English Bay. Then embark on an unforgettable journey with your map through the lush landscapes and vibrant history of Stanley Park, Vancouver's crown Jewel! 
Scoot down to Coal Harbour , immerse yourself in breathtaking beauty of scenic coastal vistas as you explore this urban oasis. 

Loop back down to False creek seawall and visit Granville Island. Explore all it has to offer from artisan stores, Public market as well as food courts.

A captivating tour revealing fascinating stories and hidden gems.
